name: account-sync-failure-retried-at-usage-sync
description: E1 answers 503 at the 00:01 ACCOUNT_SYNC (14:01:00Z); E6, E7, E4 and E5 of that sync still run. Every later release and E2 succeeds and no E1 follows them; the next E1 is at the 12:01 USAGE_SYNC (02:01:00Z), where E1, E6 and E7 run again before E4 and E5. The tariff group stays ok on the start-up snapshot.

answer.body: upstream connect error or disconnect/reset before headers. reset reason: connection termination
